sections.title: New Jersey's Defining AI Markets
sections.description: ClickMasters builds AI specifically for New Jersey's world-class pharmaceutical, financial, healthcare, and logistics sectors.

items.title: Pharmaceutical and Life Sciences (New Jersey's Most Significant AI Market)
items.description: New Jersey is the 'Medicine Chest of the World' — more pharmaceutical companies are headquartered in New Jersey than anywhere else on Earth: Johnson & Johnson (New Brunswick HQ) — drug discovery, clinical trial management, manufacturing process AI, commercial analytics; Merck & Co. (Rahway HQ) — drug discovery AI, oncology analytics, vaccine manufacturing AI, clinical research ML; Bristol Myers Squibb (Princeton HQ) — clinical trial AI, patient stratification, drug combination analytics; Pfizer's NJ operations — manufacturing process AI and clinical data analytics; Genmab, Sanofi, Bayer US — global pharmaceutical companies with NJ operations. ClickMasters pharmaceutical AI capabilities: drug discovery ML (molecular property prediction, target identification, ADMET modeling), clinical trial optimization (patient recruitment, protocol optimization, site selection), manufacturing PAT (pharmaceutical process AI), pharmacovigilance (adverse event signal detection), regulatory submission intelligence (LLM and NLP for FDA submission document processing).
items.label: Pharma specialty

items.title: Financial Services
items.description: Morgan Stanley (NJ operations campus), Goldman Sachs (Jersey City), Deutsche Bank (US operations), and the broader Jersey City/Hoboken financial services community adjacent to Wall Street. The regulatory compliance requirements for NJ financial services AI are effectively identical to New York — SR 26-2, FCRA, ECOA, and FINRA standards apply.
items.label: Financial services

sections.title: New Jersey Pharmaceutical AI: FDA Regulatory Context
sections.description: New Jersey's pharmaceutical manufacturing and research operations are among the most FDA-regulated environments in the US.

items.title: FDA SaMD for Clinical AI
items.description: AI systems used in clinical research or clinical decision support may be subject to FDA Software as a Medical Device guidance — ClickMasters designs NJ pharmaceutical AI with FDA SaMD awareness and strongly recommends qualified FDA regulatory affairs counsel for classification determinations.
items.label: FDA SaMD

items.title: GxP Compliance Context
items.description: Pharmaceutical manufacturing AI in New Jersey's FDA-inspected facilities must be developed with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) software validation principles in mind. ClickMasters designs pharmaceutical manufacturing AI documentation with 21 CFR Part 11 awareness where electronic records are involved.
items.label: GxP

items.title: NJ DOBI and Financial Regulation
items.description: New Jersey Department of Banking and Insurance oversight for NJ-regulated financial institutions — ClickMasters designs NJ financial services AI with DOBI requirements alongside OCC federal oversight.
items.label: Financial compliance
